description: The statistics page of Lebanon's Ministry of Public Health brings together the ministry's published charts and tables on the health system and population health. For health services, it offers the number of hospitals contracted by the ministry by governorate and hospital type, admissions and in-patient stays subsidised by the ministry by district and hospital type, both for 2017, and the medical centres and beneficiaries of the chronic drugs programme by governorate for 2016. It also carries immunisation coverage, a table of selected indicators for 2017 to 2024, maternal and neonatal mortality trends to 2025, and HIV and tuberculosis charts. The files are free to download as PDFs and images. Caveats: the service tables stop in 2017, most files are charts, not data, the page mixes Arabic and English, no licence is stated, and the ministry's contracting data leave out hospitals without contracts. Coverage is national with district breakdowns. Simulation uses: a baseline of hospital distribution and publicly financed admissions by district for health capacity and crisis planning in Lebanon. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) offers facility locations for Lebanon to pair with these counts.
